title: New Business Unit Administrator
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a New Business Unit Administrator based in Northampton for one of our clients on a Full time permanent basis.

Summary of the New Business Unit Administrator role

Salary: £25,750
Location: Northampton
Type of Contract: Permanent
Hours: 35 hour working week Monday - Friday 9:00am - 5:00pm - Hybrid working available

Responsibilities of the New Business Unit Administrator
- Process new client and new matter opening requests
- Review file opening forms and supporting documentation
- Maintain accurate records and documentation
- Act as a point of contact
- Provide clear updates on onboarding progress and outstanding requirements

Requirements for a successful New Business Unit Administrator
- Previous Administration experience
- Awareness of AML, CDD, Sanctions and conflict search requirements
- Knowledge of client and matter onboarding systems
- Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
- Problem-solving and organisational skills

About Allstaff Recruitment

We re an independent recruitment specialist based in Bedfordshire, supporting businesses across Bedford, Milton Keynes, and surrounding areas. We recruit for permanent, temporary, and contract roles across multiple sectors.

Check out our jobs page for our latest vacancies in your area and follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Northampton 27,000 - 29,000 DOE Temporary to Permanent

Are you an experienced Sales Administrator looking for a role where you can take ownership, work closely with customers and become a valued part of a growing business?

We're working with an established manufacturing business based in Northampton to recruit a Sales Administrator into a brand-new position created due to continued growth.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the commercial side of administration - speaking to customers, supporting sales activity, keeping things organised and making sure opportunities don't get missed.

You'll work closely with the sales team, supporting the day-to-day sales operation while also having the opportunity to get involved in areas such as reporting, customer analysis and some general business administration.

There is a small amount of finance administration within the role, including supporting with invoices and purchase orders, but the main focus is Sales Administration and customer support.

Why is this a great opportunity?

This is much more than a traditional sales admin position.

The role has been created from scratch, meaning you'll have the opportunity to put your own stamp on it, improve processes and take ownership rather than simply following the same routine every day.

The business is well established but continues to grow, offering the successful candidate the chance to develop alongside the company and build a long-term career.

You'll be joining a small, friendly team where people work closely together and everyone has an important part to play. If you're someone who likes being busy, getting involved and seeing the impact of your work, this could be a really good fit.

Who are they looking for?

We're looking for someone with previous experience in Sales Administration, Sales Support, Customer Service Administration or a similar commercial role.

You'll ideally be:
- Confident dealing with customers over the phone and email.
- Experienced in supporting a sales team and managing customer enquiries.
- Comfortable preparing quotations, processing orders and keeping customer information up to date.
- Confident using Sage - this is essential.
- Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Naturally proactive - someone who sees what needs doing and gets on with it.
- Commercially minded, with an interest in customers and sales.
- Confident working with spreadsheets, data and reports.
- Happy to get involved with some basic finance administration when required.

You do not need to be an accounts professional. We're primarily looking for a strong Sales Administrator with Sage experience, a confident telephone manner and the right attitude.

What's on offer?

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, initially joining on a temporary basis for approximately 3 months, with the intention of moving into a permanent position following a successful placement and mutual suitability.

Once permanent, you'll receive:
- 28 days' annual leave.
- Paid Christmas shutdown, in addition to your holiday allowance.
- Private healthcare.
- Long-term career development opportunities.
- The chance to help shape a brand-new position.
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and scope to develop.
- A supportive, close-knit working environment.
- The opportunity to build a long-term career within an established and growing manufacturing business.

The person we're looking for

If you're a good Sales Administrator who enjoys speaking to customers, supporting sales and being proactive, we'd like to hear from you.

We're not looking for someone who needs to tick every box. More importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude, commercial mindset and willingness to get involved.

If you're looking for your next move and want a role where you can make an impact, develop your skills and grow with a business, this could be the opportunity for you.

Apply today or contact Impact Recruitment for more information.
